data.title: SpaceX revenue jumps 92% but stock tumbles as investors weigh AI spending | CNN Business
data.description: SpaceX first earnings report as a public company blew past expectations. But it continued to burn through cash in pursuit of CEO Elon Musk’s vision for an AI-powered, Mars-colonizing future, putting investors on edge and sending SpaceX shares down in late trading.
data.author: Allison Morrow
